summary.en: Grünenthal concentrates on pain, with a partnered Phase 3 cell therapy and proprietary earlier-stage analgesics. Tegacorat extends development into Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
summary.zh: Grünenthal专注于疼痛领域,拥有合作的III期细胞疗法和自有的早期镇痛药。Tegacorat将开发延伸至杜氏肌营养不良。

ind.en: Chronic low back pain with degenerative disc disease
ind.zh: 伴椎间盘退变的慢性下腰痛

ind.en: Acute postoperative pain; broader acute and chronic pain research
ind.zh: 急性术后疼痛;更广泛的急慢性疼痛研究

next.en: KF7040-21 Phase 2 results expected in early 2028
next.zh: KF7040-21 II期结果预计于2028年初公布

watch.en: Qutenza met the EMA-aligned AV001 endpoint but missed the FDA-aligned endpoint; no US sNDA is planned.
watch.zh: Qutenza达到与EMA一致的AV001终点,但未达到与FDA一致的终点;不计划提交美国sNDA。

watch.en: Palexia and Nebido loss of exclusivity affected 2025 revenue.
watch.zh: Palexia和Nebido的独占期结束影响了2025年收入。
